Name: Joash, the King's Son
Summary: Joash, the king's son at Ahab's court, was named with Amon the governor as custodian of the imprisoned prophet Micaiah.
KeyStory: Ahab ordered Micaiah carried back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king's son.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Micaiah, Son of Imla
LifeLesson: Proximity to power does not excuse silence when truth is imprisoned.
